name: Bohème Cosmétique
description: French brand selling organic skincare, body care, essential oils, wellness items, herbal teas and gift sets, made in Aix-en-Provence. Its FAQ mentions shipping offers for France and Belgium, with relay-point delivery.
description_es: Marca francesa que vende cosmética ecológica, cuidado corporal, aceites esenciales, bienestar, infusiones y cofres de regalo, elaborados en Aix-en-Provence. Su FAQ menciona ofertas de envío para Francia y Bélgica, con entrega en puntos relais.

ships_to.notes: FAQ mentions shipping offers in France and Belgium with Chronopost Pick Up and Mondial Relay relay points; Corsica and DOM-TOM not mentioned in the FAQ.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Relay-point delivery is offered; the pages read do not describe collection at the Aix-en-Provence shop.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: Homepage reports dispatch within 24 to 48 business hours; free relay delivery in France and Belgium.
